summary: NO-SHIP. F1 is resolved. F2 satisfies the accepted partial contract and documents its intentional residual honestly, but its implementation introduces a new high-severity false-positive path. F3 is resolved. F4 was not reopened.
triage: review-gate SKILL.md § Triage governs: render EVERY finding as a full table row, never inside a dialog; then ask the ROUND before the rows — take every Proposed decision as it stands, or decide row by row — and `as proposed` ends the round in that ONE action; only if row-by-row was chosen, ask per finding with that row's Proposed decision as the first option, a reject or defer taking a free-text reason; echo back ONLY the rows that carried free text, and none if the round was decided by selection alone; max 2 rounds, append decisions.md and COMMIT it with this artifact.

findings.title: The F2 fix fingerprints element violations with an unrelated closed sibling
findings.body: `enclosingElement` collects preceding opening tags without consuming closing tags, then also qualifies element-name spans. Oxlint's existing diagnostic at `src/features/modifications/rule-form.tsx:355` spans only `div`; the algorithm selects the already-closed `<span>` at line 349, producing the committed `span.div` key at `scripts/a11y-baseline.txt:11`. Renaming that unrelated sibling changes the fingerprint while the violating div is untouched, so this hard gate rejects ordinary markup edits and may prompt a baseline refresh that blesses real additions. The new tests at `scripts/a11y-gate.test.mjs:130-143` cover attribute spans only.
findings.recommendation: Keep element-name diagnostics as their own name (`div`, `label`). Qualify only attribute diagnostics using the actual owning JSX opening tag, preferably through an AST or balanced scan. Add a child-process fixture that renames or reorders a closed preceding sibling while leaving the violation unchanged and requires PASS.

findings.title: The committed verification evidence does not cover the final README
findings.body: All 16 gate results and 838 tests are pinned to `d1bc828`, but the following commit `f99b6eb` changes both this evidence document and `README.md`. README is an input to the hard test suite through `scripts/readme-parity.test.mjs:21-24`, so the claim that the trailing commit cannot change a verdict is false: the recorded run predates the README it purports to cover. Review-time test execution does not repair the missing committed final-tree evidence.

| 검증한 커밋 | `d1bc828d094365c9f01d2b36563ef1d8a189e8bf` |
| 트리 객체 | `a11f7292d72b01c6d00245c51f55ec8c360139cb` |

| 빌드 산출물 | `.output/chrome-mv3` — `*.js` 15개의 집계 해시 `c8f7149121e81e83` |
| 기기 | darwin/arm64 · Apple M5 Pro · 18코어 · 48GB |
| 런타임 | node v24.14.1 · bun 1.3.11 |

빌드가 **결정론적**임을 확인했다 — `.output`을 지우고 두 번 빌드해 위 집계 해시가 같았다. 그래서
이 문서의 결과는 위 트리 객체에 귀속된다.

**핀이 HEAD보다 하나 뒤일 수 있다.** 위 커밋은 게이트를 **실제로 돌린** 트리이고, 그 뒤에 오는
것은 이 증거 문서를 커밋하는 변경뿐이다 — 문서는 빌드에도 스위트에도 들어가지 않으므로 판정을
바꾸지 않는다(README만 예외이고 그것은 `readme-parity` 테스트가 잰다). 판정을 바꾸는 변경이
뒤따랐다면 그때는 이 표를 다시 채워야 한다.
findings.recommendation: Place every README change before the verified commit, run the full hard gate set on that final code-and-README tree, then add only the verification document in the trailing evidence commit.
